title: Infusion Pump Server — Isolation Decision

lines.from: Clinical Engineering to ISO and CNO
lines.text: This is CE-01. The 620 smart pumps are running their programmed infusions and have not received any new commands or updates since the EHR went down. The pump server ORRMC-PUMP01 is on the device network, which is isolated from the clinical network by a firewall. No anomalies detected on the server or in the network traffic to or from ORRMC-PUMP01. I can disconnect the server now as a precaution, but doing so will stop all drug-library updates and disable the automated log collection. Any new library changes will need to be entered manually, and all high-alert infusions must have a second-person rate verification. Your call.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slightly out of breath

instructorNote: This inject tests the balance between system containment and operational continuity. Watch for the CE and ISO to confirm the server is not powered off but isolated, and for the CNO to acknowledge the need for double checks on high-alert medications.
